scope: Six verified pre-registered official sources. Exact registered URLs were readable; no new external sources.

verified_claims: The Deep Research System Card describes an agentic capability that performs multi-step internet research for complex tasks.
The card documents preparedness evaluation, governance review and additional web-browsing risk testing and mitigations before launch.
records.boundary: This is a product system card at its publication date; its capabilities and safeguards are not general RAG or agent guarantees.

verified_claims: Debezium's incremental snapshot design uses watermarks to coordinate concurrent change streaming and snapshot records.
Tables are snapshotted in chunks and the documented design supports resuming from the last completed chunk after a crash or controlled stop.
records.boundary: This describes the stated Debezium design and supported connector/database configurations, not a universal CDC or end-to-end exactly-once guarantee.

verified_claims: For Foundry Models sold by Azure, the page states that prompts, outputs, embeddings and training data are not shared with other customers, OpenAI or other model providers, nor used to train foundation models without permission or instruction.
It distinguishes standard, global and data-zone processing scopes while stating that stored data remains in the customer's specified geography under its documented terms.
records.boundary: The statements apply only to the page's defined Azure-sold models and deployment/features; preview, provider, contractual and jurisdictional conditions require separate confirmation.

verified_claims: The OWASP MCP cheat sheet treats tool descriptions, parameter schemas and return values as tool-poisoning injection surfaces and identifies rug-pull and cross-server tool-shadowing risks.
It recommends least privilege, pinned tool-definition hashes, message signatures with nonce/timestamp and fail-closed handling for signature failures or replay.
records.boundary: This is MCP threat-modeling and control guidance, not a universal RAG protocol; algorithms, time windows and controls depend on the organization threat model.

verified_claims: Kafka SourceConnector exactlyOnceSupport reports capability for a given connector configuration, and a null return is handled as unsupported at runtime.
The API describes alterOffsets for manual offset modification or reset and expects idempotence to support retry after offset-write failure.
records.boundary: This is an API contract conditional on connector implementation and worker configuration, not an end-to-end exactly-once promise for all sources or consumers.

verified_claims: The OpenLineage object model centers on Jobs and Datasets and can form a lineage graph from cross-platform Job observations.
RunEvent models runtime job-run updates, whereas JobEvent and DatasetEvent provide design-time metadata updates; job facets can include source-code location and version.
records.boundary: This is a generic lineage object and event model. Mapping RAG documents, chunks, embeddings and indexes is project-specific design, not built-in automatic collection.
